stem: Which of the following statements about HSCT is wrong for patients with mantle cell lymphoma (MCL)?

options.A: The benefit of high-dose cytarabine for young and fit, newly diagnosed MCL patients is proved in prospective clinical trials.
options.B: Auto-PBSC consolidation is superior to inferferon maintenance after primary chemotherapy.
options.C: Rituximab maintenance after auto-PBSC improves progression-free survival (PFS) but not overall survival (OS) in phase III LyMa trial.
options.D: A second auto-HSCT is not better than allo-HSCT for patients failing a first auto-PBSC.

stem: Which statement about HSCT for patients with follicular lymphoma is wrong?

options.A: Auto-HSCT should not be used in first response
options.B: A MAC (myeloablative conditioning) regimen offers better outcomes than a RIC (reduced-intensity) regimen in patients with follicular lymphoma who undergoes auto-HSCT
options.C: Auto-HSCT achieves a 5-year PFS of approximately 50%.
options.D: The superiority of either auto-HSCT or allo-HSCT as not been established.
options.E: Auto-HSCT may cure some patients and is associated with lower toxicity compared to allo-HSCT.
